_synthetic: Fictional organisation and system, created for the SAAF hackathon. No real data.
name: RetailCredit Score v3
intended_purpose: Score creditworthiness of natural persons applying for consumer loans up to EUR 75,000 and recommend approve, refer or decline.
description: Gradient-boosted model supplied by ScoreCo B.V. and hosted in ScoreCo's cloud. Applications scoring below 420 are declined automatically without human review; applications between 420 and 560 are referred to a credit officer.
decision_subjects: Retail customers and prospects (natural persons) in the Netherlands
